summary: All plan tasks (Phases 1-5, TASK-1-1 through TASK-5-6) are fully implemented. The core change replaces aggregate container/agent counts with per-agent role+status symbols in the DAG visualization box, adds a shared _get_agent_status_symbol helper to eliminate duplicated mapping logic, updates generate_status_report to return agent detail lists, and includes 6 new tests covering all planned scenarios. All 35 DAG visualizer tests pass. Code follows existing patterns, handles edge cases (no agents, 4+ agents line wrapping, ASCII mode), and introduces no security concerns. The 1 pre-existing test failure in test_state_store.py is unrelated.
